translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Mzle Jiszs Trnzlxngitilru Nide
Mz nibr kzdung mzli, nigr badr Jiszs sc tqoklatipekr mztea ngr Gzlili Provins. Trsutiu drtwrde nzvz-krde Judiz Provins, murde kxnzetu r lr Jiu nzrpilr nanibqlr nide.
Mzli lc nzyrlwr-lxblrngr kc tzrpibz Matelq ycpe pipz nzkaputr-krmle.
Zbz mzle Jiszs sc tzrpipebzlr bade kx, “Rlasz mrka x vzdz Judiz, murde leplz nemqng namc-kzpzlr rkx kcng tqaelwapx-ngrn.
Nzmu kx tqsuti drtwrm nzamatqngr nim, bzkq ale-kapqq rkx kcng tqaleq, a' aelwapxngr mzlilxlr, murde nakrlzti lr nrlc amrlx.”
Krlc tqkxmu nzycmne-krdr lc, murde trnzlxngitikalr nide.
Sc tqrpipebz Jiszs badr kx, “Mzli r nzvz-krnge mrla trkrlzkapzle. A' nimu mzli kx yctxp, sa tqtakitrde nimu.
Lr nrlc trnzsutiu drtwrdr nzatrkati-krdr nimu, a' suti drtwrdr nzatrkati-krdr ninge, murde nzpi-zvz-krbo badr kx nqmq krdrng trka.
Vzdzamu esz'-krmu mz nzyrlwrngr lc, a' namnctxpwo murde mzli r nzvzdz-krnge mrla trkrlzkapzle.”
Natq lcng pibz Jiszs badr, x sc tqmnctxpepwz Gzlili.
Jiszs Alvztr-ngrde Lou Ngr Sabat
Mz nibr nzvzdzkr mzledeng Jerusalem, nigr badr Jiszs sc tqvzdz-kapqpebzkr. X traelwapx-lzbq-ngrpwzu me nzyrlwrpx-lxblrngr, murde trsutika drtwrde nzrkrlztingr nzvzdz-kz-krmle.
Zbz kxnzetu r lr Jiu sc tzrtangrtipelr nide. X tzrpilr kx, “?Myxpe Jiszs?”
Leplz nzkqlung kx nzycmne-awang mz zbo ngr leplz kc. Kzdung nzrpilr kx, “Nide ncblo kxmrlz.” A' kzdu-kzng nzrpilr kx, “E trtingr! Murde mrlx la rmailz-rbr leplz kxnzkqlung.”
Nzpi-awa-krdr lc Jiszs trnzplzpxlru, murde nzmwxlrtilr kxnzetu rgr.
Kx krlzbzle kc vau r wiki lc, Jiszs vztr Mangr-nzangiongr sc tqalvztrpe elr.
Kx nzxlrbz kxnzetu r lr Jiu nzalvztr-krde nzkctitxpxlr, sc tzrpipelr kx, “Mrlx lc trsikluneu mz Lou scgu. ?A' myx me twzkimle da lcng tqpipxleng?”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Da lcng tqalvztr-ngrne trnzvzdzpqngqu mz drtwrnge. A' da lcng aelwa-ngrm Gct, kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle ninge.
Doa kx nartrngzbz me pnz drtwrde, sa nakrlzle kx nzalvztr-krnge vz-nqblq-zvzle me pnz drtwr Gct.
Murde doa kx ycmnetr-ngrde zmatq ngrde esz'-krde, suti drtwrde nzangiongr nide. A' doa kx yc mz drtwrde nzangiokr leplz Kxetu rde, ncblo kxmule lcde tubq x trpokiau.
Mosis rkabz bamu Loukxtr. A' trpnzngr nimu kx rvz-nqblq zvz natqdeng. X mz drtwrmu rpiamu kx xpqbrlr-ngrne Lou ngr Sabat. ?E delc tqrpi-ngrnamu nanibq-ngrnamu ninge?”
Nzrpibzlr leplz kx, “Eke, drka' la tqmncpxm bam. ?Neke rpile nanibqle nim?”

Rpibz Jiszs mz kxnzetu r lr Jiu kx, “Kzdq mzli wzx mz Sabat mz nzamrlz-krnge ncblo. A' yrkelvzamu ninge. A' nimu wz-kzamu mz Sabat mzli kznikeng vz-nqblq-ngrnamu Lou sc Mosis, mz nzrpakrngr doa ncblo. (A' lou lc vz-pnz-kaip x lou sc Mosis kc ate.) Murde nzmu zbq ngr nzrpakrngr kx tqtaole mz Sabat, sc tqrtrngztipebzmu nzrpakrngr. X da lc tubq mz drtwrgu. ?A' memule tqngyatingr drtwrmu ninge, mz nzamrlz-atwrnr-krnge ncblo mz Sabat?
Bzkq obqti-txpwzmu da kx yctrpz yz, a' nzaolvz-krmu da natutr mz da kxtubq.”
Me Vzkim Kxnzmcpx
Kzdung lr Jerusalem nzrpilr kx, “Mwx ncblo lc tzpi kxnzetung kx nanibqlr.
Rlr! A' se tqycmnetxpxpebz mz mz leplz kxnzkqlung x trpnzngr nidr kx ayzlubzle natqde. ?Myx kxmule, nzkrlztrpebz kxnzetu rgung kx ni-angidrpede Kxnzmcpx?

A' trtingr. Murde krlzku kx mzli kc navz-ngrm Kxnzmcpx trpnzngr kx narkrlz me navzkimle. A' mrlx lc krlzku mztea nyzde, dekc trnangini-ngrdeu Kxnzmcpx.” Krlc tqkxmu nzycmne-krdr lc, murde mz drtwrdr nzrpilr kx Jiszs mzte nzmc mztea Naszret.

A' trnzkrlzlru kx mzte nzmc Betleem, mztea nyz Kxnzmcpx, mz nzatutr-krde natq profet kcng bqnc. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mz nzalvztrkr Jiszs kc Mangr-nzangiongr, nate plxtxpxle mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Rpiamu kx krlzamu ninge x me vzkimc. A' trkrlzwamuu me vzkimc. Murde trvz-lzbqpwc'u, a' atwzlr-ngrmle ninge Gct angidr. X trkrlz-kzwamuu nide.
A' ninge kx rkrlz angidr nide, murde vzpxmc bade x atwzlr-ngrmle ninge.”
Kzdung leplz kx nzxlrbzlr nzycmne-krde lc, sc tzrpipelr nalolvzpelr murde rpile kx vzpxm mz Gct. A' trpnzngr kx kabzle mqde, murde trkrlzkapzle mzli r nzrnibqngr nide.
A' leplz kcng tzlxngitilr nide, sc tzrpipelr kx, “Mwx, nide Kxnzmcpx kc tzpi navzm. Murde ale rkx kxkqlu.”
Kx nzxlr kzdung Farzsi nzpi-awa-krdrle, sc tzaveatipelr kzdung pulis ngr Mangr-nzangiongr nzlolvz-krdr nide.
A' mzli kc tzkaputr-ngrbz pulis lcdeng, nzlalztqbzng bade. X sc tqrpipebz Jiszs mz leplz lcng amrlx kx, “Mzli r nzmnc-krbo bamu trboipeu x ninge kc tqyzlupe-mopwc' mz Gct kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle ninge.
Mzli lcde, sa nartangrtiamu ninge, a' trnamcwamuu ninge. X trtxpnzngr nzvz-krbzmu mrkc namnc-ngrne.”

Sc tzrpipe kxnzetu r lr Jiu kx, “?Mrlx lc navzkile drlve kc tqrpi-ngrde trpnzngr nzmc-krgu nide? ?Myx kxmule, navz mz kzdung kz nrlarnrlc kcng tqaclve kz King r Rom? ?X na-alvztrle lr Jiu kcng tzmncng mrlcdeng x lr mrlcde kcng tzmnc-mrbrng?
Rpile kx sa nartangrtiku, a' trpnzngr nzmc-krgu nide. X trpnzngr nzkrlz-krbzku mrkc namnc-ngrde. ?Nike tqkxmu nzycmne-krde ke?”
Jiszs Rka Lue Ngr Nzlungr
Mz milzpq ngr zbq krartqmz ngr Matelq, Jiszs tulzm Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe, sc tqetumipe natqde nzrpi-krde kx, “Doa kx drtwrde brlxkz navzm bange, murde narmnq lue ngr nzlungr kxmrna.”
“Murde kxnzlxngitilr ninge sa na-atutrlr Nzryrngrkxtr kc tqrpile kx, ‘Lue ngr nzlungr sa nangqtr-zvzbz mz nabz leplz.’”
Lue ngr nzlungr lc, tqycmnetrngr Jiszs ngi Mqngrkxtr, kc nakabz mz leplz kcng nalxngitilr nide. A' mzli lc tqycmne-ngrde, Mqngrkxtr trvztrkapz mz nabz leplz. Murde Jiszs trnzglqlzka.
Kzdung leplz kx nzxlrbzlr nzycmnekr Jiszs, sc tzrpipelr kx, “Mrlx lc ni-angidrde profet kc tqaenzliku, tqapule Mosis.”

X kzdung nzrpilr kx, “Eu, mrlx lc nide angidr Kxnzmcpx ne Gct.” A' kzdu-kzng nzrpilr kx, “Trtingr, Kxnzmcpx nzmu trvzpxpuu Gzlili. Murde Nzryrngrkxtr rpile Kxnzmcpx navzpxm mz nqvi lr Devet x mzte namc Betleem, taon nyzde.” Kc tqmu nzycmne-krdr lc, murde trnzkrlzlru kx Jiszs mzte nzmc Betleem, a' nzrpilr kx mzte nzmc Gzlili Provins.
Zbz drtwrdr kc tresz'tipeu.
Kzdung nzrpilr nalolvzlr nide, a' trpnzngr kx kabzle mqde.
Kxnzetu R Lr Jiu Nzpxtxpx-ngrdr Jiszs
Zbz pulis ngr Mangr-nzangiongr sc tzyzlupebzng esz'-krdr. X kxnzetu rdr kcng tzatwzlr-ngrdr nidr mz nzlolvz-krdr Jiszs, sc tzrpipebzlr badr kx, “?Memule tqvz-ngrmamu esz'-krmu?”
A' mz nzmrlzkr badr natq Jiszs, nzrpibzlr kx, “Trgalr ncblo kx myaszpxle nzycmne-krde.”
Nzrpi-mopwz Farzsi kx, “?Memule, angqngupe-kzle nimu x sc tqlxngitipe-kzamu nide?
?Xlrpe-kzamu dq ena nigr kx lxngitile mrlx lc?
Trtingr. A' leplz lcng trnzkrlzlru Lou scgu. X sa na-ayrplapx Gct leplz lcng.”
Zbz Nikodimzs, kc tqvzbz mz Jiszs mzli kc ena, rpibzle mz Farzsi kztedeng kx, “Mz nzvz-nqblq-angidr-krde Lou scgu, trtakitrpleu nzpi-krgu kx ncblo vz-rbr, a' nalalztq-kaipzku mz nzycmne-krde.”
Zbz kxnzetu kcng sc tzngyatipe drtwrdr nide. Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “?Memule, ni-kzp lr Gzlili? Na-aoti drtwrm Nzryrngrkxtr, murde rpile kx trpnzngr profet kx naprpxm Gzlili.”
Olvz Kx Rmwimi Ncblo Kzble
Kx yrkrpxbz nzycmnekr Farzsi lc, sc tzaki-lzbqpeng, tzyzlupeng mz ma nyzdr.

footnotes.text: Mz nzyrlwr-lxblrngr lc mz Septembz o Oktobz, lr Jiu adcpx mz drtwrdr mzli kc melrmqdrng tzmncngr mz matelq x tent mrkc lzke badr Mosis. Kxmule-esz' nzrnginyzdr ma, a' nzmncpxmqng mz matelq mz zbq rlimz. X mz zbq lcdeng nzrtwztrng lue x nzawoung kadol Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe. Murde yc mz drtwrdr nzrka-krbz Gct mqdr lue, x nzmailz-krde nidr mz nyr mrkc lzke.

Mz zbq krartqmz lc, lr Jiu nzyzlupeng ma nyzdr, mz nzyckr drtwrdr nzprtr-krdr drtc' kc tqesalz-ngrbz Gct badr, tzrpi-ngrbz Kenzn. A' trnzrtwztrung lue x trnzawou-kzung kadol Mangr-nzangiongr. Krlc zbq kx myapxbz x nzyrlwrngr kx ngi Matelq kc tqyrkrpxpe mz milzpq ngr zbq lc. [Livae 23:36]
Kzdung nzryrkr Jon kcng pnz trnzyrlqtrpwzu mz ngalrdeng 7:53—8:11.
